page.layout: One column of dictionary entries with Hebrew and Syriac characters, page number and running head at top; catchword-like signature at lower right ("טלל"). Show-through from the reverse page is not transcribed.

main_text.l: טִין טִינָא Ch.Syr.Coenum, Lutū, בְּחַסַף טִינָא Cum luto coeni, Daniel.2.41.
טִיר Ch.Cōjectare,augurari: Experiri, experimento discere,Considerare,examinare. Aphel אַטְיֵר Idem,Genef.30.27.in T.Hierosf.
ܛܝܪܐ Syr.Caula, ovile. Joh.10.16. Chald.dicitur דִּירָא. Vide suprà in דּוּר.
טך Syr.Fortasis, forsitan, ad Roman.5.7. Est Græc. τάχα.
טכם Ch. Instruere, accingere, ordinare. Pahel טַכֵּם Idem.
מִטְכְּסָא Ch. Mundities, ornatus, ornamentū, Esth.2.12.
ܡܛܝܢܐ Syr. Moderatus, ordinatus, compositus, 1.ad Timoth.3.2.
טִכּוּם Ch.Ornatus, ornamentum, Exo.28.8. & 39.5. in Targ.Jon. Resp.Heb. אֵפֹד, Amictus,amiculum.
טלא טליא טלי טלה Ch.& Syr. Infans, puerulus, adolescens,puer. Plur.טְלִין, emph. טַלְיָא Psal.148.12.
Fœm. טליתא, ܛܠܝܬܐ Syr. Puella, Plur. טליתא, טליין Puellæ.
טליתא Ch.Puella, טליתא יאיא בריוא Puella pulchra aspectu, Esth.2.8. in Targ.sec.
טליותא, טליות Ch. & Syr. Pueritia, adolescentia, juventus, מן טליותא A' pueritia.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Greek forms are transcribed as far as legible; the Hebrew and Syriac vocalisation is uncertain in several entries. Ghosted text from the reverse page is not transcribed.
